chapter: The Meadow (meadow) - regenerated on the desert's ember model (#904): a hummable mid-register guitar lead the ear can follow, a tune that goes through a second section and a build, the sunshine carried by warm guitars and a steady beat rather than by shrill, toy-like highs
purpose: Master of Game/Music/bloom-sunny.ogg: written from this file by Tools/MusicBake --tracks --masters <this folder>, brought to the themes' loudness, peaks held under full scale, Ogg Vorbis. The master stays outside the repository (C:/Users/panrd/AI/output/masters-904-chosen on the desktop, with its .raw.wav; every candidate is in masters-904); this sidecar is committed beside the .ogg.

format: 48000 Hz, 32-bit float PCM, stereo -- 48 kHz is the model's fixed native rate

request.caption: Sunny feel-good pop-rock instrumental with a hummable tune: a warm clean electric guitar playing a simple memorable melody a listener could hum back, strummed acoustic guitar and warm electric piano chords under it, a round warm bass guitar, a steady upbeat pop drum groove on kick, snare and toms with a dark ride cymbal, a gentle first section with the tune over the strumming that lifts into a fuller second section where a second guitar harmonises the tune and the drums drive harder, then a build into the last chorus, optimistic and friendly, warm mid-forward mix, modern production, wide stereo mix with guitars panned left and right, the full band playing throughout, no vocals

chosen.why: Chosen by measurement: no column measure-music.py bolds is outside ember's range (its pitch wobble 1.6 and detune 1.5 cents sit under ember's lowest, which only means steadier), measured on the baked recording: 64 s loop (32 bars at 120 bpm), loop cut context match 0.988, rhythm r 1.00 against 0.81 a bar later, spectrum cosine 1.00; 15.7 % in 300 Hz-4 kHz and 1.5 % above 6 kHz (the replaced recording: 10.8 % and 3.0 %); tonal mid 82 %, 3.4 held-note changes a second; 6.6 short gaps a minute (replaced: 38.2); the opening repeats 1 bar at 0.90 and at 0.93 (replaced: all 40 bars); 0.0 % of held notes out of C major; 0 clipped runs after the bake (140 in the master). The block profile moves: the level swings 4 dB and the spectrum of each 8 s block resembles the first block's at 0.68-0.89, so the arrangement goes somewhere. Judged by numbers only: the tune, the warmth and whether the build lifts are for the owner's ear.

replaces.why_replaced: Measured 2026-10-17 beside ember: 3.0 % of the energy above 6 kHz (ember at most 2.0), 38.2 short gaps a minute (ember at most 27.0) and an opening repeat of all 40 bars (every bar near-identical to the first; ember 1.4-7.5 s), and the owner's note of 2026-10-16 (translated from Czech): it is hard to tune into the melody, it sounds a bit off, as if slightly out of tune and without an idea (#904). The pitch itself measured inside ember's range (wobble 2.9, detune 1.7 cents, 0.0 % of held notes out of C major): the pitch is therefore not what the note names; the arrangement and the timbre are what it can still be about.
